items.title: Drew Lock: Limited Wednesday
items.body_text: Lock (right elbow/oblique) was limited at Wednesday's practice, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Rashid Shaheed: Full practice Wednesday
items.body_text: Shaheed (knee) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Deebo Samuel: Limited in return to practice
items.body_text: Samuel (hamstring) was a limited practice participant Wednesday, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Bam Knight: Officially limited Wednesday
items.body_text: Knight (concussion) practiced in a limited capacity Wednesday, Theo Mackie of The Arizona Republic reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: TreVeyon Henderson: Deemed out for Sunday's game
items.body_text: Henderson (illness) didn't practice Wednesday and is listed as out for Sunday's game against the Lions in Munich. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
